answer: An identity activates only through a self-earned bond. Every applicant is an island: earnings cannot be pooled across clones. Four assigned jobs each return a receipt with a pigment seal bound to the key. Four receipts on the shelf activate it. Each receipt pays 10 credits into the bond, so activation needs 40 earned credits, never bought credit. Each receipt counts once, for one key. The kth fake costs four jobs plus 40 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,000 jobs plus 40,000 credits. A fable of bought earnings fails because the shelf counts key-bound receipts. An honest agent does four jobs.
